card.name: Linking words in asthma and allergy labels
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right before a drug name or condition, in asthma, allergy and hypersensitivity label text. Typical spots are 'hypersensitivity to', 'interactions of', or a comma in a list of asthma therapies.

modes.label: After hypersensitivity
modes.description: The word 'to' after 'hypersensitivity' in contraindication statements, before a drug name.

modes.description: A comma or 'or' inside a list of asthma or allergic-disease therapies or conditions.

modes.label: Other link words
modes.description: 'of' or 'to' linking an effect or exposure to an inhaled steroid.
